records.text: Training to momentary muscular failure is not a universal requirement. Most users can accumulate productive work while stopping short of failure, especially on technically demanding compound lifts. Failure may be used selectively on safer isolation exercises. Deloads are a coaching tool, not a biologically mandatory calendar event: consider them when fatigue, performance, motivation, soreness or life stress indicate that a temporary reduction in workload may help. Evidence does not support one universal deload protocol.

Plateau checklist: verify attendance and logging; review technique and range; check load jumps; assess sleep, nutrition and stress; confirm goal realism; consider whether the plan is too easy, too hard or too variable. Change one meaningful factor and monitor for several weeks rather than changing everything at once.
